completionDecision.reason: Wave 22 located and retained the official Alaska Division of Elections 2024 General ENRbyPrecinct.csv from the All Details page. The new normalized artifact loads 523 same-grain precinct/reporting-unit President versus U.S. Representative named-candidate first-choice review rows. Presidential totals reconcile exactly to the certified summary report; U.S. House named DEM/REP candidate totals reconcile exactly, while the ENR precinct CSV does not itemize 750 statewide U.S. House write-in votes included in the summary PDF. Certified map results remain statewide only and AK remains map-disabled until a reviewed geography/crosswalk decision is made.

loadedArtifacts.sourceTitle: State of Alaska 2024 General Election Election Summary Report, official results
loadedArtifacts.caveat: The official summary report remains the certified statewide source and includes U.S. House write-in votes at statewide grain only.

loadedArtifacts.sourceTitle: Alaska Division of Elections 2024 General ENR precinct summary CSV
loadedArtifacts.caveat: Official CSV exposes same-grain President and U.S. House named-candidate first-choice rows. It does not itemize U.S. House write-in rows by precinct/reporting unit, so comparison_other is 750 votes below the statewide summary comparison_other value.

loadedArtifacts.sourceTitle: Normalized AK precinct/reporting-unit President versus U.S. House review rows
loadedArtifacts.caveat: Rows are advisory source-review inputs only. They include non-geographic absentee, early, question, and remote reporting units and should not be treated as precinct polygons.

loadedArtifacts.sourceTitle: U.S. EAC Election Administration and Voting Survey 2024 V2 turnout fallback
loadedArtifacts.caveat: EAC fallback turnout matches the Alaska summary report statewide Times Cast and registered-voter figures. The ENR precinct CSV has registered-voter fields but active turnout remains EAC fallback until denominator timing and reporting-unit semantics are reviewed.

displayCaveats: Current AK certified result rows are statewide only; map capability remains disabled.
Review rows are official precinct/reporting-unit source-review rows, not proof of fraud or misconduct.
U.S. House comparison rows are ranked-choice first-choice named-candidate rows and omit 750 statewide write-in votes not itemized in the ENR precinct CSV.
Rows include Election Day precincts plus absentee, early, question, and remote reporting units; do not join directly to precinct polygons without a reviewed crosswalk.
